name: my-flow
description: Managed worktrees, guarded frontend reviews, one enforced SSH Host, and GitHub approval gates.

interface.shortDescription: Managed worktrees, frontend reviews, and guarded publishing.
interface.longDescription: My Flow remembers a target directory and SSH Host alias, runs guarded UI and UX frontend review rounds, restricts Git transport to the selected alias, refreshes bare repositories at agent startup, and requires explicit approval for GitHub publishing.
defaultPrompt: Review this frontend with separate UI and UX passes.
Prepare this GitHub push approval request.
